decisions.reason: The ceiling and floor pipe bracket draws directly on the firm's existing steel fabrication, welding and coating knowledge, so the firm can read its market results and keep improving it within its core infrastructure offer.

The pipe support bracket is closely related to the firm's established pipeline components and certified welding expertise, which gives it strong absorptive capacity to refine and sell it to the same utility and contractor customers.

The public waste bin uses the firm's powder-coating equipment but serves a street-furniture market where the firm has little customer and design knowledge, so it is vulnerable, though municipal buyers overlap enough to justify keeping it for now.

This multi-model waste bin line with ashtray is far from the firm's knowledge base and harder to learn from than its core products, but it shares coating capability and municipal customers with the firm's existing business, so management keeps it while watching it closely.

The outdoor ashtray line is the most distant from the firm's pipeline expertise and has weak learning links to its core business, giving a sizeable withdrawal risk, but it remains in the street-furniture range alongside the bins for now.
